lab.title: Deploy a Resilient Web App on Azure
lab.objective: Provision a virtual network, a Linux VM, and an App Service in West US 2, and confirm the app responds.

currentStep.title: Create the virtual network and VM in the lab region
currentStep.instruction: In the Azure Portal, create resource group 'rg-app' in West US 2, then deploy the VNet 'vnet-app' and a Standard_D4s_v5 VM into it.
currentStep.expectedOutcome: A VNet 'vnet-app' and a running VM exist in West US 2 inside resource group 'rg-app'.

validations.description: Resource group 'rg-app' is in region westus2
Virtual network 'vnet-app' exists in region westus2
